title: Older Adult Activity: An Overview
limited_summary: Adults 65+: activity amount is individualized to ability; weekly aerobic, strength and balance guidance. Does not establish a universal three-run limit for everyone over 60.

title: AHA: exercise after heart attack
limited_summary: Selected heart-disease patients may undertake HIIT in cardiac rehabilitation; not universal clearance or universal prohibition.

title: Develop a Physical Activity Plan for You
limited_summary: Work with healthcare team to choose intensity after cardiac events.

title: Swimming and Your Health
limited_summary: Water exercise can benefit health and allow exercise with less joint pain. This does not mean joints are unused.

title: Medical misinformation policy
limited_summary: Policy concerns harmful medical misinformation contradicting local health-authority guidance. This is not a YouTube clearance decision.
